RunSnapshot.description: The story with its boards embedded, every asset version the build reads pinned by content hash (or definition_signature for a voice, input_signature and take hashes for a board voice), the requested toolchain and any applicable visibility overrides. It holds no run ID or run time. Identical frozen inputs and approvals yield the same canonical bytes and hash. The story's own fields are checked by studio.story/v1.

RunView.description: The contract's fields are id, story_id, number, status with wait_reason, the snapshot (its sha256, the story revision, the board count and the blob's locator), queued_by, queued_at, idempotency_key, the estimate, progress, stages, outputs, checks, provenance (toolchain, engines, inputs_externally_generated, usage, public credits), delivery_id, legacy, started_at and finished_at. Story 406 proposes the rest: transitions (every status change with time, actor and reason), error (the code, board and stage a failed run stopped at), phase, and the per-board and per-check detail fields listed below.
